bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for safety improvements on the Pokegama Bridge trail system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the snowmobile trails and enforcement account in the natural resources fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Itasca County for safety improvements on the Pokegama Bridge trail system. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for safety improvements on the Pokegama Bridge trail system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the snowmobile trails and enforcement account in the natural resources fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Itasca County for safety improvements on the Pokegama Bridge trail system.
additions: $50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the snowmobile trails and enforcement account in the natural resources fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Itasca County for safety improvements on the Pokegama Bridge trail system.
